breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the distributed-load case with its midspan resultant when computing deflection, but an equivalent resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the standard formula δw = (5wL^4)/(384EI) for the full-span UDL case, rather than replacing the distributed load with its resultant acting at midspan. This matches the ground truth approach and avoids the incorrect substitution described in the inconsistency.
